literal: أحضر لحم الخنزير المقدد إلى المنزل بدون رسوم.
adaptation: لقمة عيشك توصل لبيتك كاملة.. ومن غير ولا قرش رسوم.
back_translation: Your daily bread reaches your home in full... and without a single piaster in fees.
notes: Bacon is pork, which is forbidden in Islam and offensive to most Egyptians, so I swapped it for the beloved Egyptian idiom 'لقمة العيش' (daily bread/livelihood), which keeps the 'earning a living' meaning, and used 'ولا قرش' to stress zero fees in local colloquial phrasing.
